finding: PBDE concentrations in mature males increased over the ten-year period.

contaminant: POPs (PCBs, DDTs, mirex, CHLs, HCHs, PBDEs)
finding: Most POPs other than HCB showed downward temporal trends, consistent with regulatory restrictions.
Bioaccumulation profiles differed before and after the Fundão dam collapse; pesticide concentrations increased after 2015.
Increasing temporal trends coincided with dredging events and other environmental disturbances.
Organochlorine pesticides and PCBs increased after the 2015 Fundão collapse, peaking again after 2019 extreme weather events; MeO-BDEs decreased.
